verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform with a standard app UI; the evidence pack shows only manual navigation flows (menus, screens like Accounts → Limits) and no natural-language command interface, chatbot, or agentic control surface. There is an llms.txt file which suggests machine-readability but not that end users can operate the product via natural language. Missing for 10: any evidence of a natural-language interface, chat-based commands, or AI assistant for operating the account.
